tests/api/auth.spec.ts
Auth API
wrong password and unknown user get the same 401, so usernames cannot be enumerated
login without username is rejected with 400
login returns a JWT that opens protected endpoints
login without password is rejected with 400
registration requires a valid registration code
registration validates required fields
registering an existing username is rejected with 409
Auth API > password reset
rejects an invalid registration code
rejects a password shorter than 4 characters
returns 404 for an unknown user
new password works and the old one stops working
tests/api/leave.spec.ts
Leave requests API
a new request is pending and keeps its dates
rejects a request without type
rejects a request without start_date
rejects a request without end_date
a pending request can be approved
a pending request can be rejected
only "approved" and "rejected" are valid statuses
status change and delete of a missing request return 404
delete returns 204 and removes the request
"delete all" removes every request of the user
yearly reset archives approved requests and leaves pending ones alone
Leave requests API > known bugs
an end date before the start date should be rejected
an unknown leave type should be a 400, not a 500

services and events

tests/api/services.spec.ts
Service tracker API
creates a service and returns it in the overview
rejects a service without name
rejects a service without countType
rejects a service without costType
rejects a service without cost
updates every field of a service
update validates required fields
update and delete of a missing service return 404
Service tracker API > scheduled events
an event is created as upcoming for its service
rescheduling moves the date and keeps the event upcoming
validates required fields
deleting a service deletes its events
tests/api/sharing.spec.ts
Wish list sharing API
a shared list is visible to the peer as view-only
view-only access does not allow changes
the owner sees who a list is shared with, and can revoke it
revoking a share that does not exist returns 404
rejects invalid share requests
sharing twice with the same user returns 409
tests/api/tasks.spec.ts
Tasks API
creates a free task with no price or currency
creates a paid task in UAH, keeping the price to the cent
creates a paid task in USD, keeping the price to the cent
creates a paid task in EUR, keeping the price to the cent
rejects creation when name is missing
rejects creation when type is missing
rejects creation when month is missing
rejects creation when a paid task has no price
rejects creation when a paid task has a non-numeric price
rejects creation when a paid task has no currency
lists only the requested month
filters by completion status
requires the month query parameter
"today" returns the current month tasks
marks a task as done
switching a task to paid requires a currency
update and delete of a missing task return 404
delete returns 204, then the task is gone
Tasks API > known bugs: database constraints leak as 500
a negative price should be a 400, not a 500
an unsupported currency should be a 400, not a 500
an unknown task type should be a 400, not a 500
Tasks API > carryover
moves tasks to the target month with the given statuses
validates required fields
tests/api/user.spec.ts
Profile and settings API
"me" returns the profile of the token owner
updates yearly leave allowances
allowances need both values
saves the dashboard tab order
tab order must be an array
Profile and settings API > change password
rejects an invalid registration code
rejects a short password
the new password is used on the next login
Profile and settings API > delete account
requires the password as confirmation
rejects a wrong password and keeps the account
deletes the account: login fails and the old token finds no user
removes the user's data too, including lists shared with others
tests/api/wishlists.spec.ts
Wish lists API
creates a wish list that the owner sees as not shared
a wish list needs a name
renames a wish list
delete returns 204 and removes its items too
Wish lists API > items
a free item has no currency or amount
a paid item keeps its currency and amount
rejects an item without a name
rejects an item paid without an amount
rejects an item paid with a non-numeric amount
rejects an item paid without a currency
partial update changes only the sent fields
an update with no fields is rejected
items cannot be added to a missing wish list
